name: NBC Silverwater
access_notes: Purpose-built badminton hall (part of NBC's 7-site Sydney network), 3-layer sprung timber floor with international-standard mat overlay. Entry via Holker St carpark next to Apollo Blinds. Confirmed social/casual sessions: Wed 20:00-23:00, Fri 20:00-23:00, Sun 20:00-23:00 (Intermediate to Advanced) — full daily operating hours and general court-hire pricing not published; use same booking platform pattern as other NBC sites (Alexandria, Castle Hill, MQ Park, Olympic Park, Seven Hills).
notes: Two conflicting phone numbers found across secondary sources (+61 2 8041 1130 vs +61 2 9008 5485) — neither confirmed on an operator page render, so phone left null. Full opening hours and per-hour court pricing not found on nbcbadminton.com.au or yepbooking directly; only casual-session windows confirmed.

name: Five Dock Leisure Centre
access_notes: Run by City of Canada Bay; 8 dedicated badminton courts, casual hourly hire, bookable up to 4 weeks ahead, 48hr cancellation policy, payment required at booking (no cash). Note: published off-peak window (6am-4pm) falls partly outside listed facility opening hours (starts 9am) — likely a legacy rate description, flagged as a caveat.
notes: fdlc.com.au also operates Concord Oval Recreation Centre; combined marketing copy referenced '24 courts across two locations' — the 8 badminton courts figure here is specific to Five Dock Leisure Centre per City of Canada Bay's own venue page.

name: Menai Indoor Sports Centre
booking_platform: Attekus / Sutherland Shire Council online booking
access_notes: 4 multi-purpose courts hosting badminton alongside basketball, netball, indoor soccer, volleyball, gymnastics, martial arts and dance programs. Sunday availability is 'by request' rather than fixed public hours, shown here as closed/unlisted.
notes: Direct fetch of Sutherland Shire Council's own Menai page was blocked (403); facts assembled from search-engine snippets of the council domain plus a secondary directory (badmintoncourt.au, phone +61 2 8536 9777 there differs from council-listed 02 9532 0444 — flagged conflict). No badminton-specific pricing found.

name: Marie Bashir Mosman Sports Centre
access_notes: Council's own venue page and venue-hire policy describe exactly 'one multi-function playing court with provision for indoor sports such as netball, basketball, indoor hockey and futsal' — badminton is not listed anywhere as a supported sport.
notes: Confirmed via Mosman Council's own site that the single multi-function court is configured for netball/basketball/indoor hockey/futsal only; no badminton line-markings or booking category found on operator or any secondary source.
